title: Neuroprotection and Disease Treatment through Synthetic Peptides and Activated Protein C
summary: This cluster revolves around the use of synthetic peptides and activated protein C in neuroprotection and disease treatment. Synthetic peptides are involved in bioengineering and biotechnology processes, and mimic proteins. They also have a function in protein mimics. Activated protein C has a function in neuroprotection. Cryptococcal meningitis patients and HIV seropositive patients are associated with disseminated cryptococcosis and influenza H1N1, respectively. Protease activated receptor is a component of blood and has a function in neuroprotection.
